newsitem.title: USA: Wet Seal sees Q1 EPS higher than yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Wet Seal sees Q1 EPS higher than yr ago.

text.p: Young women's apparel retailer Wet Seal Inc said it expects first quarter earnings of about $0.23, compared with $0.06 in the prior fiscal year first quarter.

"The improvement in the earnings for the first quarter is due primarily to the increases in comparative store sales which exceeded our expectations," said Kathy Bronstein, West Seal vice chairman and chief executive.

"Our sportswear business continues to perform well, in particular our own private brands. Additionally, we are very pleased with the success of our newly-added merchandise categories, shoes and cosmetics, which have been rolled out to the majority of our stores," Bronstein said.

Wet Seal previously announced plans to open about 30 stores in fiscal 1997, including three Limbo Lounge stores, and plans to further accelerate store growth in fiscal 1998 to about 75 stores. Wet Seal is testing Limbo Lounge as a new store concept for both young men and women's fashions.
A new distribution and office facility, which will accommodate future growth, is currently under construction. The company said it expects to be operating in the new facility by year end.
